`Symfony\Component\HttpClient\NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient` is documented as a decorator that blocks requests to private networks by default. A run of whitespace placed before a separator could be divided among the iterations of the enclosing repetition in exponentially many ways, and the engine tried all of them before settling. `HeaderBag` calls it for the `Cache-Control` header whenever a `Request` is built, so any application handling HTTP requests is reachable, with no authentica

expect.note: Every HTTP request builds a Symfony Request (Laravel/Octane FrankenPHP); HeaderBag::set for 'cache-control' calls parseCacheControl (HeaderBag.php:150-151,267-269) -> HeaderUtils::split with the vulnerable regex (HeaderUtils.php:53-61). Unauthenticated attacker controls the Cache-Control request header.

Symfony: Unbounded Recursion in the YAML Inline Lexer Lets a Single Document Crash the Process — ### Description

`Yaml\Parser::lexInlineStructure()` recursed through `lexInlineMapping()` and `lexInlineSequence()` for every `{` and `[` of an inline collection, without entering the nesting level that the rest of the parser bounds with `maxNestingLevel`.
